race.description: More From Tote With Ladbrokes Mdn
race.comment: WOUNDED EAGLE (5) is first-up following an 18-week spell. Showed ability in the maiden campaign, the peak run coming on debut when runner-up over this distance at Hobart. Will no doubt have furnished over the break and better things might be in store this prep. OLINDAH (13) is another returning from a break. Tackled some rich juvenile races in her first prep and wasn't up to that level. Trialling in great style and this looks a far better platform to launch the new campaign. MISS STRAT (9) settled well back and only warmed to the task late when resuming over 1100m at this track last time out. Has raced just once over today's trip and was beaten a long neck at Hobart. Big chance in this far more suitable contest. THE RED SHE DEVIL (11) worked through the line in good style to grab fourth when fresh from a break over 1100m here recently. Lightly raced mare who is well in after the claim. EFFRONTERY (7) can improve after a satisfactory return here 23 days ago.
